cau-hoi.heading.4: A few things to know as you explore PAO.
faqs.0.1: PAO OS is an AI business operating system developed by IVN Network. It aims to connect assistance, knowledge, plans, tasks and reports within a shared business context.
faqs.1.1: PAO is designed around SMEs, startups, founders, CEOs, business owners and marketing teams who want a clearer way to organize work and collaborate with AI.
faqs.2.1: Conversation is a starting point. PAO aims to connect business context with plans, specialist roles, review steps and work outcomes.
faqs.3.0: Can PAO work with different AI models?
faqs.3.1: PAO supports the selection of models and AI connections within its supported scope. Actual availability depends on configuration, providers and the business's data requirements.
faqs.4.1: PAO helps connect briefs, goals, audiences, messages, content plans and performance context. Platform connections, publishing and advertising actions require agreed permissions and deployment scope.
faqs.5.1: PAO is designed to support and coordinate work. People still define goals, supply context, review quality and decide on important actions.
faqs.6.1: PAO is designed around business-scoped context and permissions. Data sources, access scope and AI connections should be selected to meet each organization's security requirements.
faqs.7.0: How can I learn more about PAO?
faqs.7.1: Contact IVN Media at cs@pao-os.com or through the hotline to discuss your needs, product scope and a suitable way to explore PAO.
